exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Faithful HD PAINTED GAME diffuse UV texture.

Image1 is the exact ENTIRE native stored RGB edit target 256x256. Image2 is ONLY that identical whole source enlarged4x with nearest pixels, to expose the existing tiny paint pattern. Both are the same single canvas. Output ENTIRE same aspect 256:256 canvas and UV, same orientation, no margin/crop/padding/repacking/rotation/zoom. Original full selected alpha restored numerically after this edit.

Preserve exact entire source charcoal-black SOFT DIFFUSE painting and original dull gray-purple upper polygon wash. The polygon outline keeps source faint gray light strength without bright rim; preserve old two gray rectangles, belt and tiny dim source strokes, upper curved dark wash and right narrow pale marks. The lower semicircular brown source gradient has EXACTLY TWO old dim brown sampled points plus the old broad central light wash; preserve those same two source points at identical UV positions and faint source intensity, do not add further points or brighter studs. All lower gray fields retain broad smooth source gradient with unchanged old faint scratches. Flat fields stay flat; no grindinggrain, pitting, wear enhancement, extra folds, new hardware or raised bevels.

Only improve painted resolution inside the EXISTING shapes. Preserve original palette, matte or shiny material, low contrast and brush softness, relative local lights, all original black gaps/cutouts, and pattern count and scale. Do not redraw little marks into new symbols, add weave/thread/grain/pores/stitches, new folds, bright bevels or hardware. No photograph, new anatomy, new text or new objects. This must remain a faithful old painted game UV texture, no portrait or assembled garment.
